manifest.title: text -> ndjson{suite,name,status}
manifest.purpose: Parse TAP output written by node --test into NDJSON: one JSON object per test with keys suite, name, status. Test names must keep leading and trailing spaces exactly.

contract.title: Parse TAP output written by node --test into NDJSON: one JSON object per test with keys suite, name, status. Test names must keep leading and trailing spaces exactly.

target.label: ndjson{suite,name,status}

fields.name: name
samples: retained composition links real runs and survives restart without copying raw execution data
withdrawal and changed dependency defeat historical success without granting authority
a refused saved goal cannot erase the last completed dependency evidence, including after restart
missing or truncated completed history cannot make a failed retained goal look current
refusals, unavailable plans and failed checks are real events without provider-error leakage

properties: Pure and deterministic: the same input always gives the same output.

domain: tested from 0 to 0 records per input
limitations: Evidence comes from finite testing. This does not establish correctness outside the stated domain, or universally.
evidence.assessment: Independently verified within the stated domain: 7 held-out cases passed with value-level oracles, and 11/18 injected value faults were caught.

enforces: no host mounts: source and input arrive over stdin, so the home directory and the Docker socket are unreachable
read-only root filesystem; writes only to a size-limited noexec tmpfs that disappears with the container
all Linux capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, unprivileged uid 65534
no host environment variables are passed into the container
hard cgroup limits on memory, swap, process count and CPU
wall-clock timeout enforced by this process and inside the container; output capped by this process
notEstablished: protection against a container-runtime or kernel escape
a covert channel through timing or resource use
attestation of the timing and memory figures, which are reported from inside the container

limitations: Evidence comes from finite testing. This does not establish correctness outside the stated domain, or universally.
Node's TAP writes a real newline or tab in a test name and a literal backslash sequence as the same bytes, so such names cannot be recovered from TAP by any program.
One record per leaf test. A parent test with subtests, and a suite, appear in the suite field of their children, not as records, so counts match Node's JUnit reporter and not the TAP summary line.

revalidation.instructions: Re-run the stored suite through the pinned oracles; compare the consumer's outputs with the stored witnesses.
